sections.name: ValueCaveatsNote
sections.title: Showing the caveat paragraphs
sections.what: Shows a bordered box with a heading and one paragraph per stored note. If there are no notes, it shows nothing.
sections.why: The file's comment says these notes are shown even when the matching column is empty, so alternatives stay in view.
sections.watch_out: If the stored notes are not separated by blank lines, they will show as one long paragraph.

summary: Shows a small box of notes on values that are disputed, partial, or dated, one note per paragraph, and shows nothing when there are no notes.
purpose: Keeps alternative figures and caveats visible to the reader, even when the main value column is empty.
why: The file's top comment says imports store these notes so that alternatives are never hidden, and the box appears for every industry.
how: 1. Check that the note is text and not blank. 2. Split the text into paragraphs at blank lines. 3. Remove extra spaces and empty paragraphs. 4. Draw a bordered box with a small heading and each paragraph in order.
inputs: One value called caveats. It is expected to be text from the project's attributes field named valueCaveats, with paragraphs separated by blank lines.
outputs: A box titled Notes on disputed or partial values, or nothing at all.
risks: The text is shown as the importer stored it, so a typo or odd line break appears to the reader. Line breaks are kept on screen, so long lines can stretch the box.
debug: If the box is missing, check that valueCaveats is saved on the project, is not blank, and is a single piece of text. If paragraphs run together, check for a truly blank line between them. The test id value-caveats marks the box on the page.
